overall: No violation found: the Chair did not reasonably anticipate discussing the proposed warrant article 48 hours before the October 7 meeting, though the AG recommended tabling unplanned topics of public interest for a later notice.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly discussed and voted on a zoning warrant article (Article 23) at its October 7 meeting although it was not listed on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: After communications with counsel for the Board and the Complainant, and in the absence of any evidence to the contrary, we credit the Board's account that the Chair had not anticipated a discussion of Article 23 48 hours prior to the October 7 meeting.
